The International Smart City Conclave 2025 is a landmark event aimed at showcasing the state’s progress in urban development and modernization.

This event will spotlight Delhi & Uttar Pradesh’s advancements in areas such as Smart Buildings & Future Cities, Renewable & Clean Energy, Clean Environment, Water Conservation & Rejuvenation, Urban Mobility, Smart ICT Solutions and IoT.

This conclave will provide a platform for Union and State Government officials, Foreign Delegations, Smart City Leaders, Municipalities, Development Authorities, Town Planners & Architects, Real Estate Professionals and Industry Experts to collaborate on the future of smart urban development.

This conclave will bring together expected 2,000+ delegates including Smart City CEOs, Mayors, Ambassadors, Senior Government officials, Industry leaders and Tech Companies from expected 20+ countries.
International Delegation Including G20 Countries.
Participate in hands-on sessions and expert-led discussions.
Round Table Discussions are designed to provide practical knowledge and insights.
Engage with global experts and learn about the extensive opportunities available for established businesses.
Renowned speakers across different sectors will deliver insights on Smart Cities.
Keynote speeches will cover current trends, future outlooks, and inspiring stories that will motivate attendees.
In the lead-up to The International Smart City Conclave, Organisers will host a series of National and International road shows across major cities in Uttar Pradesh & Abroad.
These road shows are designed to build excitement and provide a glimpse of what to expect at International Smart City Conclave.
